# Nacre Brain

This private local folder is the durable knowledge bank shared by your Codex and Claude accounts.
Open this folder as an Obsidian vault, or use `nacre-brain search WORDS`.

| Folder | Content |
| --- | --- |
| inbox | New facts and task handoffs awaiting organization |
| personal | Personal preferences and context |
| projects | Project summaries and pointers to canonical repository instructions |
| infrastructure | Dated host inventory, access methods, environment boundaries |
| devices | Device identity, last verified address, hardware evidence |
| runbooks | Repeatable operational procedures |
| decisions | Reasons behind durable choices |
| credentials | Secret-store references only; never secret values |

Search before adding a note. Record a source and verification date; distinguish
observed facts from user reports and unverified historical assumptions. Recheck
host identity before acting on a saved address. Keep project rules in the project.

Notes belong to your OS user, not your ChatGPT account. They are not automatically
available to ordinary ChatGPT web chats. Codex reads them through your global
instructions and personal skills. The public OS repository contains only the
tools and templates, never this folder or Codex account state.

Use `nacre-brain note --help` to save a unique note without concurrent writers
overwriting one another. Use `nacre-brain store-credential NAME` to put a secret
in the OS keyring, then document only its reference. Keyring secrets are not
automatically copied to other hosts. This folder is not a backup by itself.
